Die Fahne: SPALTEN mal ZEILEN Punkte im: The flag: SPALTEN times ZEILEN points, 14 apart, the first column
am Mast (fest), jeder Punkt mit dem link: on the pole (fixed), and every point linked
to its left and its upper neighbour.
Boeen: der Wind schwillt an und ab, alle: Gusts: the wind swells and dies down every few seconds.
Eine Welle, die vom Mast weg durch den S: A wave that runs through the fabric away from the pole.
schwillt langsam an und ab, für alle Pu: swells and dies down slowly, the same for all points — so the whole flag rises and falls. The
hängt von der Zeit UND vom Ort ab:: depends on time AND on position:
hat an jeder Stelle einen anderen Wert: has a different value at every place and moves to the right over time, away from the pole. That is how a wave runs through the fabric. Incidentally, the wind could only push a curtain seen from the front to the side: fluttering goes out of the picture, and this picture has only two directions.
Der große Ball räumt den mittleren und d: The big ball clears away the middle and the right-hand tower; what is left is a heap of blocks, and only the left tower still stands. A ball with radius 30 has a good four times the area of one with 14, and the physics gives it correspondingly more mass. At the same speed it carries four times as much momentum into the towers.
Die Säulen biegen sich, als wären sie au: The columns bend as if they were made of rubber, and blocks stick partly into one another: in big steps the physics only notices a contact once the bodies already overlap, and then pushes them apart with a jolt. On top of that, everything runs more slowly. PHYS2D_STEP takes at most 0.05 seconds at a time; fifteen steps per second are therefore only three quarters of a second of physics.
Mit demselben Zug wie vorher fliegt der: With the same pull as before, the ball flies almost straight and far over the towers. On the Moon you aim directly at the target and pull down less to do it. If something then falls over, it falls leisurely, as if in slow motion.
Neun Steine, schmal und hoch, etwas weni: Nine bricks, narrow and tall, a little less than one brick height
auseinander: Wer faellt, trifft den naec: apart: whichever falls hits the next one.
Die Steine sind 60 hoch und 34 auseinand: The bricks are 60 high and 34 apart. When one tips over, it hits the next one at about half its height. A gap of more than 60 would mean: it falls flat on the floor, and the chain breaks. You have to aim flat, because a ball in a high arc flies right over the low bricks.
Ein fester Haken, eine schwere Kugel, ei: A fixed hook, a heavy ball, a rope in between — and a line that draws the rope, because the world knows about the rope, but the picture does not (code/loesungen/kap10_abrissbirne.dh):
Oben ein fester Haken, links davon die B: At the top a fixed hook, to its left the ball, on a rope 280 long. It
haengt zuerst lose und schwingt dann nac: hangs slack at first and then swings to the right into the towers.
Das Seil: eine Linie vom Haken zur Birne: The rope: a line from the hook to the ball.
Die Abrissbirne ist in die Türme geschwu: The wrecking ball has swung into the towers and is swinging back; the middle tower has buckled.
Am Anfang ist die Kugel 276 vom Haken en: At the start the ball is 276 away from the hook, but the rope is 280 long: it hangs slack, and the ball first falls a little until the rope pulls taut. From then on the rope pulls the ball onto an arc around the hook. A rope only pulls, it never pushes — hence PHYS2D_ADD_ROPE, “at most this far”.
Eine Möglichkeit (code/loesungen/kap10_b: One possibility (code/loesungen/kap10_bruecke.dh): two fixed posts, twelve planks in between, and a hinge at every place where two of them touch:
Zwei Pfosten, oben auf Hoehe 230; dazwis: Two posts, their tops at height 230; 12 planks in between. Every two
Nachbarn haengen an einem Scharnier dort: neighbours hang on a hinge at the place where they touch.
Ein paar Kloetze, die auf die Bruecke fa: A few blocks that fall onto the bridge.
, einer halben Brettlänge links von der: , half a plank's length to the left of the plank's centre — where the plank touches the one before it. The first plank hangs on the left post, the last on the right. Compare this with Chapter 9: there it was points and links, and we wrote every line of the calculation ourselves. Here they are real planks with width, onto which blocks fall and stay lying — with a handful of commands.
in_back holt Schwung: Der Punkt fährt er: in_back winds up: the point first moves a little to the left, behind the start, and then faster and faster to the right — the counterpart of out_back. inout_elastic swings at both ends: at the start it quivers around the start, then shoots across in a few wide leaps and at the end quivers around the target, a little beyond it. in_bounce does a few small hops on the spot at the start and then sets off. The rule behind it: in_x is out_x played backwards.
Mit spaeter(0) kommen alle vier Knöpfe g: With spaeter(0) all four buttons come at the same time, as one block — the staggering is gone, and the menu immediately feels stiffer. With spaeter(i * 0.3) the last button waits for 90 percent of the time and has to cover the whole distance in the remaining 0.12 seconds: it shoots in. The delays should be small enough that all the buttons still have enough time for their journey.
s bestimmt, wie weit die Kurve über das: s determines how far the curve overshoots the target. With s = 0, zurueck becomes the formula 1 + q³ — exactly out_cubic: arriving gently, without overshooting. With s = 1.70158 it is about ten percent of the distance, around 53 pixels. With s = 4 it is almost forty percent, over 200 pixels: the buttons fly far to the right and then come back, as if they were on a rubber band.
Zwei Funktionen, die p bekommen und den: Two functions that receive p and return the share of the distance, and two more tweens (code/loesungen/kap11_eigene.dh):
Vier Stufen: der Weg in Spruengen, dazwi: Four steps: the distance in jumps, standing still in between.
Geradeaus, aber mit einem Zittern, das z: Straight ahead, but with a tremble that dies away towards the end.
treppe rundet p auf Viertel auf: Bis p =: treppe rounds p up to quarters: up to p = 0.25 the point is already a quarter of the way along, then it stands still until p goes past 0.25, and so on. A tween whose curve jumps simply jumps too. zittern is p plus a small wave, and
lässt sie zum Ende hin ausklingen, dami: makes it die away towards the end, so that the point arrives exactly at the target. A curve may do anything as long as it returns the value 1 at p = 1 — otherwise the tween ends somewhere other than at its end.
Ein eigenes kleines Programm (code/loesu: A small program of its own (code/loesungen/kap11_kette.dh). A stretch is two tweens, one for x, one for y, with the same curve; each corner has the curve with which the movement continues from there:

anderen. Ist eine fertig (TWEEN_DONE), b: other. When one is finished (TWEEN_DONE), the next one begins.

Eine Möglichkeit (code/loesungen/kap11_t: One possibility (code/loesungen/kap11_titel.dh): every letter of the title gets a tween for its height, with a bounce curve that, like spaeter, is shifted by a small delay:
Huepfen wie ein Ball, der aufschlaegt: d: Bouncing like a ball that hits the ground: three arcs, each one flatter.
Eine Huepfkurve, die erst nach dem Antei: A bounce curve that only starts after the fraction `verzug`.
Der Titel: jeder Buchstabe ein Tween fue: The title: each letter a tween for its height.
Das Menue kommt erst, wenn der Titel fas: The menu only comes once the title has almost settled.
huepfen ist aus drei Bögen gebaut: erst: huepfen is built from three arcs: first a fall all the way down (4 · p² reaches 1 at p = 0.5), then a small jump up to 88 percent and back, then a tiny one. The menu now travels twice as long and only begins after 45 percent of the time — when the title has almost settled. Everything rests on the same tool: a function that makes a curve.
Mit 10 Grad wird der Baum schmal und hoc: With 10 degrees the tree becomes narrow and tall, its crown a fan like a broom. With 60 degrees the branches bend back downwards after three forks, and a pattern of hexagons appears, like a honeycomb. With 0.5 a small sapling remains: the branches shrink so fast that everything above the trunk put together is shorter than the trunk itself — 110 · (0.5 + 0.25 + …) stays below 110. With 0.85 it becomes huge, grows out of the top of the window, and the branches cross: the lengths above the trunk add up to a good 470 pixels.
Bei Tiefe 14 sind es 32 767 Linien statt: At depth 14 there are 32,767 lines instead of 1023 — each extra level of depth doubles them. You can hardly see a difference: the new twigs are 110 · 0.72¹⁴ ≈ 1 pixel long, and the crown only gets a little denser at the edge. You pay with time: on my computer the program dropped from 60 to 50 frames per second. More depth than the eye can resolve is wasted.
Der Farn wird schlanker und steht steile: The fern becomes slimmer and stands more upright, more like a feather or a blade of grass. A single angle in the blueprint changes the whole plant, because it takes effect at every branching in every generation.
Eine Neigung, die in jedem Bild aus der: A tilt that comes from the clock in every frame, and ast adds it to both branches — the more, the further out the fork sits (code/loesungen/kap12_wind.dh):
Wie weit sich jede Astgabel gerade neigt: How far each fork is leaning right now, in degrees.
Je hoeher die Gabel (kleine Tiefe), dest: The higher the fork (small depth), the more it gives way.
Boeen: zwei Wellen uebereinander -- sons: Gusts: two waves on top of each other -- otherwise it looks like a pendulum.
Weil jede Gabel ihre Neigung zur Richtun: Because every fork adds its tilt to the direction of its branch, the tilt adds up towards the outside: the trunk does not move at all, the tips move the most — as in a real tree. Two sine waves at different speeds on top of each other give an irregular swaying instead of an even pendulum swing.
Die Jahreszeit ist eine Zahl von 0 bis 4: The season is a number from 0 to 4 that moves along with the clock, and blatt turns it into a colour — or -1 for “no leaf” (code/loesungen/kap12_jahreszeiten.dh):
Wo im Jahr wir sind: 0 Fruehling, 1 Somm: Where we are in the year: 0 spring, 1 summer, 2 autumn, 3 winter (and

Loesung zu Kapitel 12, Erfinden: ein eig: Solution to Chapter 12, Invent: a rule set of your own -- the
Drachenkurve. Zwei Regeln, Winkel 90 Gra: dragon curve. Two rules, angle 90 degrees; each generation folds the
Linie noch einmal. Pfeil hoch und runter: line once more. Arrow up and arrow down change the generation.
Die Schildkroete: F ein Schritt, + und -: The turtle: F one step, + and - a quarter turn. The
Farbe wandert ueber die Linie, damit man: colour moves along the line, so you can see how it folds.
So viele F stehen im Wort -- jedes F wir: This many F are in the word -- each F becomes a stroke.
Jede Generation ist um den Faktor Wurzel: Each generation is larger by a factor of root 2 -- the step
schrumpft entsprechend, damit der Drache: shrinks to match, so that the dragon fits into the picture.
Faltet man einen Papierstreifen immer wi: If you fold a strip of paper in the middle again and again and then unfold it so that every fold makes a right angle, you get exactly this curve — generation 12 is twelve folds. Each generation makes the dragon larger by a factor of √2; that is why the step shrinks by the same factor, and the picture stays the same size. The colour counts the strokes as it goes, so you can see how the one line runs through the whole picture.
Mit 20 Schritten sieht die Menge aufgebl: With 20 steps the set looks inflated: the small round buds merge with the big shape, because many points at the edge need more than twenty steps to escape and are therefore wrongly coloured black. With 1000 steps almost nothing changes in this view — the edge just gets a little finer. The program then calculates 97 million steps instead of 11 million; with machine code that still takes only 0.19 seconds. Drawing the 400,000 pixels takes longer.
Mit 2 wandert der Farbton langsam: Fast: With 2 the hue moves slowly: almost the whole picture stays in the same blue-violet, only the edge gets brighter. With 30 the colour jumps by a twelfth of the colour wheel at every step, and narrow colourful rings form around the set. The number says how much colour one step is worth.
Die Übergänge bleiben weich, aber im Hin: The transitions stay smooth, but fine arcs appear in the background where the colour makes a small jump. The formula for the fraction is only roughly right, and it is the more accurate the further out z already is when it crosses the limit. At radius 16 the error is invisible, at radius 2 it is not.
Der Punkt unter der Maus soll stehen ble: The point under the mouse should stay where it is. That is why everything moves closer to it by the same factor — the centre too (code/loesungen/kap13_mausrad.dh):

Without mirroring there are two copies facing each other, as if the sheet had been turned by 180 degrees.

If you paint the same stroke twice, it has the same colours both times.

So the same two lines make the difference between painting and something quite different: the state from one frame to the next is the brush's memory.

Mit 2 Oktaven ist ein Halbton 33 Punkte: With 2 octaves a semitone is 33 pixels wide: you hit the notes easily, but there is only room for two octaves — enough for most melodies. With 7 octaves it is just under ten pixels, and the slightest tremble of your hand puts the note out of tune; in return the range reaches from the deepest hum to a whistle. A real theremin has the same problem: the more range, the more precisely you have to hold your hand.
Mit −80 dB ganz oben liegt die ganze obe: With −80 dB at the very top, the whole upper half of the window lies below −40 dB, that is, below a hundredth of the full amplitude. Through loudspeakers you hardly hear anything there; you only play in the lower half any more. −40 dB is a good range for an instrument heard through loudspeakers — anything quieter cannot be heard over the computer's fan anyway.
Das Bild zeigt weiter einen Sinus, denn: The picture still shows a sine, because welle calculates with SIN — it shows how high and how loud, not which shape. You hear the difference at once: the square wave sounds hollow, like an old games console, the sawtooth sharp and bright like a synthesiser. Both have overtones, multiples of the frequency that sound along with it; the sine has none, and that is why it sounds as soft and round as you know a theremin to sound.

Measured: if the mouse is 4.4 semitones above the A, you get 142 Hz without snapping and 147 Hz with it — the D. The tone glides in semitones too, so that it goes as fast at the top as at the bottom. The trail now shows the note being played, not the mouse, and becomes a staircase.
Ein Modulator kann die Tonhöhe nicht fah: A modulator cannot drive the pitch, so the program calculates it itself every frame (code/loesungen/kap18_vibrato.dh):
Wie tief (in Halbtoenen) und wie schnell: How deep (in semitones) and how fast (per second) it swings.
Die Schwingung rechnet in Halbtönen: ±0,: The oscillation is calculated in semitones: ±0.25 semitones, converted with 2 ^ (halb / 12) as in step 1. At 220 Hz the tone thus wavers between 217 and 223 Hz — which is also what the recording showed, five times per second. That the program only adjusts it 60 times per second cannot be heard: there are twelve steps per oscillation, and AUDIO_PITCH glides over 4 ms for each one. Only when a frame stalls does the vibrato falter too — the price of it not being a modulator.
Eine Möglichkeit (code/loesungen/kap18_z: One possibility (code/loesungen/kap18_zwei_stimmen.dh): a second sound, a fifth higher, switched on and off with Z; R switches between two kinds of fifth:
Saegezahn statt Sinus: Er hat alle Obert: Sawtooth instead of sine: it has all the overtones, and they let you hear
Die zweite Stimme braucht einen eigenen: The second voice needs a sound of its own: AUDIO_PLAY plays a
sound only once at any one time.
Die zweite Stimme braucht einen eigenen: The second voice needs a sound of its own, because AUDIO_PLAY stops a sound before starting it again. And both voices are sawtooth waves, because only the overtones let you hear what this is about. A fifth is the ratio 3 : 2 — three times the lower note is then exactly twice the upper one, and both sound along in the sawtooth. On the piano, however, the fifth is seven equal-tempered semitones, 2^(7/12) = 1.4983, a little smaller. At 220 Hz the two overtones then lie at 660 and 659.3 Hz, and two notes that close together beat: they strengthen and weaken each other in turn, 0.74 times per second. Measured, the share at 660 Hz swelled from almost zero to its peak and back every 1.35 seconds. With the pure fifth it stood still. This is the price every piano pays for the twelve equal steps: no fifth is quite pure, but in return all keys sound the same.
Mit 12 Bändern werden die Balken breit u: With 12 bands the bars become wide and calm, and you can only roughly see whether something is going on low, in the middle or high up. With 128 the highs become fine and restless, and every note of the melody has its own line. On the left, by contrast, little changes: at the far left there are now 17 bars of equal height instead of 6. More bands do not make the low end more precise — the resolution of the FFT is not enough there, as described under “Why like this?”. Bass, mids and highs stay roughly the same, because their limits are fractions of BAENDER.
Ohne die Sperre zählt jeder Schlag etwa: Without the lock-out every beat counts about five times: after the drum strikes, the bass stays above the average for a few frames, and in each of these frames the condition holds — measured, five triggers 17 ms apart, that is, frame after frame. All you see is that the flash stays bright a little longer. But if you do something that counts on every beat — throw sparks, increase a counter — you do it five times. The lock-out of 0.2 seconds is shorter than the gap between two beats (0.5 s) and longer than a single drum hit.
Mit 0,1 je Sekunde brauchen die Spitzen: At 0.1 per second the peaks take ten seconds to cover the full height — they almost stay put as a line and show the loudest each band has been over the last few seconds. At 3 they are down in a third of a second and almost stick to the bars. In between lies what you know from level meters: the peak holds briefly so that the eye can catch it.
Statt der Balkenschleife eine, die Strah: Instead of the bar loop, one that draws rays (code/loesungen/kap19_kreis.dh):
Der Winkel: 0 oben, PI unten -- die halb: The angle: 0 at the top, PI at the bottom -- half a turn for all
Baender, die andere Haelfte ist das Spie: bands; the other half is the mirror image.
Der Winkel läuft für die Bänder nur über: For the bands, the angle runs over only half a turn, from the top (0) to the bottom (π); the outer loop draws each band twice, with seite = −1 and +1, and so mirrors the right half to the left. SIN of the angle is the step to the right, −COS the step upwards — the same calculation as for the clock face in Chapter 4, except that there the hands point to the time, and here the bands are counted from the bass. The inner circle grows with the bass, and all the rays move outwards with it: the whole picture breathes.
Der Schnitt statt des Basses selbst: Er: The average instead of the bass itself: it changes slowly, and
the colours drift instead of flickering.

The average changes slowly; the colours then drift with the music: louder bass pulls them towards green and blue, quieter bass back towards red.

The number only changes how often neues is called; everything else stays the same.

The fire turns a dull orange, as if cut out of paper, and where many particles lie on top of each other it does not get brighter but stays the colour of the topmost one. The glow is what gives a fire its heat.
Alle. Effekt.bewegen ist die Fassung, au: All of them. Effekt.bewegen is the version every subclass builds on — either it inherits it unchanged, or it calls it with SUPER.bewegen. That is why everything falls now: the shower of sparks falls faster, the snow more quickly, the flames get shorter, and the smoke rises a little at first and then sinks to the ground. One line in the base class changes every effect — that is the strength of inheritance and at the same time its risk.

Jede Szene braucht drei Sekunden, bis si: Each scene takes three seconds until it is fully there, and starts getting darker three seconds before its end — the changes become long, slow transitions. If a scene is shorter than two fades, it never becomes fully bright: rest, the distance to the nearest edge, reaches at most half the duration, and that stays below BLENDE. The fade lives in one single place, in the clock; no scene needs to know about it.
Alles verschwimmt im Schimmer: Der Titel: Everything blurs in the shimmer: the title can hardly be read, every spark becomes a small patch of light. The glow adds the shimmer of the surroundings to every pixel; times 3, it outshines the picture itself. Over the landscape it stays at 0.4, because the clock sets the strength there itself.
Der Titel läuft wie immer — aber wenn de: The title runs as always — but when the flight is about to begin, the demo breaks off: “MODEL: ungueltiges MODEL-Handle 0”, in flug.dh. Without vorbereiten the scene has not built any terrain; land is still 0, and there is no model with that number. That is why the clock calls every vorbereiten at the beginning, before the first frame — and then building does not take up any time in the middle of the demo either.
